identity.trade: Spears and discipline: the Greywatch Spear Hall drills the militia that marches under the Order of the Highwatch.

greeting: Walls first, comfort second. State your case.
The Greywatch Spear Hall is not much to look at. It is, however, ours.
rumour: Orders say hold. Hold what, and for whom, is above my rank.
Messengers ride in at night and out before dawn. They wear no colours.
The watch-fires at Highwatch burned twice last week. Nobody will say why.

opinions.aubrey_charnock: Aubrey keeps a tidy yard and an untidy mouth.

time.morning: Dawn drill. You are in the way.

dialogue.aside: Take your time, friend. I am in no hurry. I am, in fact, very good at waiting.

greeting: Sit anywhere that is not wet. The wet ones are the regulars.
Keep to the road. The ditch is for enemies.
rumour: Soldiers pay on pay day and owe the rest of the month. I keep two ledgers.
The cellar is cold and the cellar is empty. I ordered more. The order came back as promises.
A sentry saw a figure on the wall, tall and still. By the time he called out, nothing.
Every few years Greywatch has a winter nobody forgets. The old folk say this one is early.

opinions.freya_heron: Freya undercuts me. I forgive Freya. Mostly.
opinions.zeb_garrison: Zeb keeps a tidy yard and an untidy mouth.

time.evening: Evening watch. Stand easy, but not too easy.

dialogue.aside: Friend, you know I will not change my mind. Ask anyway. I enjoy refusing you.

greeting: Quick job or good job? I charge for both.
Welcome to Greywatch. Mind the Greywatch Spear Hall. Everyone does, eventually.
rumour: Spear heads, mail repair, shield bosses. The army eats iron.
The forge hums when the stones dim. Not loud. Enough to notice.
A cart of provisions came in with a weapon crate hidden under the grain. No papers.

opinions.aubrey_charnock: Aubrey has opinions about my prices. I have opinions about Aubrey.
opinions.fiske_heron: Fiske is blood. That settles most arguments and starts the rest.

time.night: Night watch. If you hear something, say nothing. Tell me.

dialogue.aside: There you are. I was just thinking of you, which is rare, and a compliment.

greeting: If it is not on the shelf, I can find it. If it cannot be found, I can find you something similar.
Greywatch is spear hall and militia. Nobody thinks to say it, but it is true.
rumour: Whetstones and bandages go first. I try not to think about what that means.
Sold three lanterns today. People are afraid of the dark again.
The armoury is short on arrowheads. The smith is short on iron. The iron is short on road.
Greywatch lives by spear hall and militia. When that fails, so do we.

opinions.freya_heron: Freya undercuts me. I forgive Freya. Mostly.

time.rain: Rain on the wall. The sentries grumble. The mud grumbles louder.

dialogue.aside: I do not say this often. It is good to see a face I do not need to avoid.

greeting: Papers, if you have them. A good story, if you do not.
You will hear Greywatch before you see it. Ask at the Greywatch Spear Hall.
rumour: Nine spears for the whole wall. I count them like sheep.
Wolves test the line at dusk. Men test it at dawn. We hold either way.
The Order sent forty recruits to the Spear Hall. Thirty stayed, ten can hold a line.

opinions.amice_selby: Amice knows the trade. I will say that for Amice.

time.morning: Dawn drill. You are in the way.

dialogue.aside: I dreamed of you last night. You were a heron. It suited you.

greeting: Halt. Ah. Not a thief. Carry on.
Strangers in Greywatch get one warning and one welcome. You are on the welcome.
rumour: Captain says it is nothing. Captain also says that about rain.
Messengers get thinner every month. Messages get shorter. That is the real pattern.

opinions.amice_selby: Amice works hard and talks harder.

time.evening: Evening watch. Stand easy, but not too easy.

dialogue.aside: Evening already? Good. My day is just starting.

greeting: Evening. Stones are lit, gate is shut, I am cold.
Discipline is the one wall that needs no mortar.
rumour: A stone by the gate flickered at midnight. I wrote it down. Nobody reads it.
The ditch and stakes held last winter. Barely. Nobody wants a harder test.
Sergeant Greyspear says a knight is just a spearman who did not quit.

opinions.ferris_rimmer: Ferris keeps a tidy yard and an untidy mouth.
opinions.hamo_swale: Hamo works hard and talks harder.

time.night: Night watch. If you hear something, say nothing. Tell me.

dialogue.aside: Come in, sit, eat. I will hear no argument.

greeting: You are somebody's grandchild. I can tell by the walk.
First time in Greywatch? The Greywatch Spear Hall is the place to start.
rumour: The old stones had names. Nobody writes them down. Nobody asks me.
Recruits are keener since the stones dimmed. Keen is not the same as ready.
When Greywatch is quiet we say it is peaceful. When it is very quiet we say nothing.

opinions.amice_selby: Amice lives next door and hears everything I do.
opinions.lyle_slater: Lyle keeps a tidy yard and an untidy mouth.

time.rain: Rain on the wall. The sentries grumble. The mud grumbles louder.

dialogue.aside: Sit. I have news. Three pieces, one of them true, I think.

greeting: Again! No, not you. The rest of you. Again!
Greywatch is a small place with a long memory. State your name slowly.
rumour: A third of the recruits cannot tell left from right. A third cannot tell either from a wall.
Old soldiers say the wall is built on something older. They stop talking when a recruit walks past.

opinions.eadric_bexley: Eadric knows the trade. I will say that for Eadric.
opinions.ferris_rimmer: Ferris lives next door and hears everything I do.

dialogue.aside: Friend. I have a deal. A small one, and only a little crooked.

greeting: Eyes front. Mouth shut. Spear up.
State your business and stand where I can see you.
rumour: Boots wear out faster than armour. Nobody budgets for boots.
The beacon on the hill was lit for a moment last night and put out. Nobody ordered it.
If trade slows, Greywatch feels it first. If it speeds up, Greywatch feels it last.

greeting: At ease. No, you at ease. I am working.
Folk come to Greywatch for spear hall and militia. Some stay for the quiet.
rumour: Recruits keep coming. Fewer keep staying.
Ask anyone in Greywatch about the Greywatch Spear Hall. You will get four stories and one fact.

dialogue.aside: A friend is a rare coin. I have spent worse.

greeting: Off duty at dusk. Do not ask before.
rumour: Sergeant says the north pass is quiet. Sergeant also says silence is a tactic.
The Greywatch Spear Hall drew a stranger last month. He asked questions and bought nothing.

rumour: Orders say hold the line. Nobody says against what.

greeting: Fit is everything. A plate that pinches is a plate that kills.
rumour: Steel from the south comes dear. The price is a crime.
The Greywatch Spear Hall has seen odder days than this. Nobody remembers when.

dialogue.aside: Punctual as ever. I would say a pun-ctual friend, but you heard it last time.

greeting: I am not lost. I am exploring.
rumour: The big kids say there is a ghost in the barn. I have not checked. Yet.

opinions.freya_heron: Freya and I share a roof and a temper. Mostly the temper.

greeting: Are you a soldier? You look like a soldier.
rumour: I saw a light in the hedge last night. Do not tell Mum.

clues.note: The armoury hasp was oiled before it was forced. Someone knew the lock.
Nailed boots, too clean for a recruit's. They stop at the drill-yard gate.
One name on the roll is rubbed out and written over. Both names are in the same hand.

stashes.say: You take three rolls of harness leather.
